newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: ABB wins $100 mln Indonesia order.
newsitem.headline: ABB wins $100 mln Indonesia order.

text.p: Swiss-Swedish engineering group ABB Asea Brown Boveri AG said on Monday it had won a turnkey contract valued at over $100 million to build a gas-fired 135-megawatt combined-cycle power plant in Indonesia.

The plant, to be located at Sengkang in South Sulawese, was placed by the independent power producer PT Energi Sengkang, which is a joint venture between PT Trihasra Sarana Jaya Purnama of Indonesia, and two Australian companies, Energy Equity Corp Ltd and Tenneco Holdings Pty Ltd.
The order was won by ABB Power Generation, Switzerland.

ABB will supply two gas turbosets and one steam turboset, as well as a 150-kilovolt high-voltage switchyard and a 34-kilometre power line to connect the new power plant to the state-owned electricity company PT Perusahaan Listrik Negara's (PLN) national grid at Soppeng, South Sulawesi. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
